messages:
cedarport_pm: Hey team — CedarPort needs to onboard a claims summarizer (EN only) trained on internal claims + support chats. Must strip SSNs and card numbers, EU hosting, HSM for signing keys, and deterministic outputs for audits. Target go-live in ~3 weeks. Can we do Private with HSM from day 1?

marta_cs: High level yes. Please upload model artifact + tokenizer and a small sanitized eval set. cc @jon-ops for infra and @qa-bot for eval.

cedarport_pm: Artifact: https://s3.cedarport.com/claims-sum-1.2.tar.gz. Tokenizer included. Data: ~70k claims, 40k chat snippets. We'll upload a 400-sample sanitized eval bundle tonight.

jon-ops: Ops notes: Private + EU region + HSM supported. We'll need VPC peering and a key provisioning window. A100 recommended for p95 < 200ms on 512 tokens. We'll reserve capacity week of go-live.

qa-bot: Proposed eval plan: Redwood Optimize harness; metrics = ROUGE/F1, hallucination rate, PII residuals (SSN/CC masking), determinism score. Need 400 labeled examples + 100 adversarial probes. Canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with auto-rollback if PII_residuals > 0 or p95 > 250ms.

legal-bot: Legal requires a redaction proof and data-flow diagram before final sign-off. Also DPO wants logs residency and retention policy. No raw transcripts persisted.

cedarport_pm: Uploading eval set + retention policy to shared bucket: https://files.cedarport.com/safe-eval now. Will include data-flow diagram. Can we demo redaction + signed response in the enablement call?

marta_cs: Yes — we'll demo redaction hook + HSM-signed response and show PII residual scan results. I'll schedule enablement Thu 9am CET.

jon-ops: Created ticket CS-8340: "CedarPort claims summarizer private EU + HSM intake" 5 assignees: marta_cs, jon-ops, qa-bot. Provisioning window estimated: 2026-04-22..2026-04-29.

cedarport_pm: Legal also asked for determinism mode and logprobs on demand for dispute cases. Can we enable deterministic sampling?

jon-ops: Yes, we can expose deterministic decoding and optional logprobs. Note: enabling logprobs will increase payload and storage if persisted; we'll keep them ephemeral and only store HSM-signed proof.

marta_cs: I'll flag account health: renewal risk = watch. Mark HIGH if post-canary p95 > 250ms or any PII leakage.

qa-bot: Once samples are in, ETA for baseline run = 48 hours. I'll post results and an acceptance checklist to the ticket.

cedarport_pm: Thanks all — will be on the enablement call and bring legal. :thumbsup:
